description: This file defines a class named 'JSON' that provides static methods for encoding and decoding JSON data, including support for special character encoding and backward compatibility methods.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: A helper class for JSON encoding and decoding operations with additional features such as special character encoding and deprecated methods for backward compatibility.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes an array into a JSON string, optionally adds security envelope and encodes special characters.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a PHP variable, with an optional default to examine an envelope (not implemented).

methods.name: encodeReal
methods.description: Deprecated method that calls 'encode' for backward compatibility.

methods.name: decodeReal
methods.description: Deprecated method that calls 'decode' for backward compatibility.
